1.name: cardboard
1.guidance: Flatten and place in cardboard/paper recycling

2.name: glass
2.guidance: Rinse glass bottle/jar and place in glass recycling

3.name: metal
3.guidance: Empty metal can/foil and place in metal recycling

4.name: plastic_bottle
4.guidance: Empty/crush rigid plastic bottle and cap for recycling

5.name: plastic_bag
5.guidance: General waste bin (or dedicated soft-plastic film drop-off)

6.name: sanitary_ppe_waste
6.guidance: Seal masks, gloves, tissues, and dressings in general waste

7.name: organic
7.guidance: Compost or biodegradable organic waste bin

8.name: battery_ewaste
8.guidance: Never bin; take to battery / e-waste collection point

9.name: hazardous_medical
9.guidance: Sharps / hazardous clinical or pharmaceutical disposal container
